content.title: Honda recalls 440K vehicles which include the Honda Odyssey model
content.text: RECALLSLexusAdd TopicHonda recalls 440,000 vehicles. See the affected model. Taylor ArdreyUSA TODAYApril 15, 2026, 12:51 p.m. ETHear this storyKeep WatchingHonda has issued a recall for more than 440,000 vehicles due to a potential airbag defect.According to the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA), the recall is due to airbags that may deploy without warning, raising the risk of injury."A software programming error can cause the side and side curtain airbags to deploy unexpectedly," the agency noted.Here's more information about the recall.Which model is included in the Honda recall?The NHTSA said 440,830 units were potentially affected by this issue. The number for this recall is UNW, and the model impacted is:2018-2022 Honda OdysseyDownload USA TODAY's app to get to the heart of news Hyundai recalls nearly 300,000 vehicles. See affected models. Ford recalls more than 420,000 vehicles. See the affected models. GM recalls over 32K Chevrolet Corvettes. See affected models. General Motors recalls over 270,000 vehicles. See affected models. FCA US recalls over 178K Chrysler vehicles. See affected models Toyota recalls 73K hybrid vehicles. See affected model.Recalls: Toyota recalls over 9K Lexus vehicles. See affected models.What should car owners do?Owners are urged to take their vehicles to the dealership to get the supplemental restraint system (SRS) electronic control unit (ECU) replaced or reprogrammed for free.Notification letters are scheduled to be mailed out in May. Owners can also contact Honda at 1-888-234-2138.Taylor Ardrey is a news reporter for USA TODAY.
